_comment: Medical schematics (ARCHITECTURE.md "Medicine"). Bandages, splint, herbal remedy, antiseptic and the basic med-kit have no schematic: they are the default set.

schematics.name: Field Dressings
schematics.description: Doc Hale's way: boil it, soak it, stitch it.

schematics.name: Painkillers
schematics.description: Takes the edge off. Not too many.

schematics.name: Antidote
schematics.description: Charcoal and bitter roots for bad food and Husk rot.

schematics.name: Antibiotics
schematics.description: Cultured from pharmacy stock. Cures an infection.

schematics.name: Blood Transfusion
schematics.description: A donor at home, a bag in the field: the downed get up stronger.

schematics.name: Combat Stims
schematics.description: One more step now, a crash later.

schematics.name: Surgical Kit
schematics.description: Real instruments: surgery goes right more often.

schematics.name: Field Trauma Kit
schematics.description: Everything a medic needs to keep someone alive until extraction.

schematics.name: Calm Injector
schematics.description: Network-grade: what Halcyon gives the Linked so they never feel fear. Doc Hale wants nothing to do with it.
